---
title: Last Refreshed
description: Display text indicating the last time the data was refreshed.
---

Displays the last time the data was refreshed. This component is useful for showing users how up-to-date the data is.

```markdown
<LastRefreshed/>
```

## Examples

### Alternative Prefix

```markdown
<LastRefreshed prefix="Data last updated"/>
```

## Options

| Prop | Description | Options | Default |
|------|-------------|---------|---------|
| `prefix` | Text to display before the last refreshed time | string | Last refreshed |
| `printShowDate` | On print/PDF, will show the date and time rather than "X hours ago". | true, false | true |
| `dateFmt` | If `printShowDate` is `true`, format to use for the date ([see available formats](/core-concepts/formatting)) | Excel-style format \| built-in format \| custom format |  |
